messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['The most recent ALERTS for your account are now available to download online.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by BT Internet to inform you that we were unable to process your most recent payment of bill.', 'As an additional security measure your access to Online Banking has been limited.', 'All accounts have been temporary suspended until leach person completes our secure on-line form.', 'On 29 Aug 2016, the card was removed from your PayPal account.', 'we have noticed invalid login attempts into your account, due to this we are temporarily limiting and restricting your account access until we confirm your identity.', 'To protect your accounts, our monitoring process recently suspended your online service.', 'You may be getting this message because you have logged in from a different location or device.', 'We regret to inform you that we had to lock your Lloyds TSB account access because we have reasons to believe that it may have been compromised by outside parties.', 'Your Internet Banking Password was entered incorrectly 3 times.', 'YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN FLAGGED AS ONE OF THE NUMEROUS ACCOUNTS THAT NEEDS TO BE REVIEWED.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and Dear Valued Customer', 'We are unable to process this payment to your account as your details has not been updated to our new database', 'Our security department have noticed an illegal money transfer screening, we noticed an issue regarding your account.', 'Your subscription is on hold.', "Methought you'd like to know that Amazon shipped your item, and that this completes your order."]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
